description: This file contains utility methods for handling exceptions related to authentication within a Hono-specific HTTP AuthHandler context, primarily processing exceptions during device authentication attempts.

classes.name: AuthHandlerTools
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for processing exceptions in Hono-specific HTTP authentication handlers.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during authentication, deciding the response based on exception type and cause, including redirect, unauthorized, or internal server error responses.
